description: This file defines an abstract class 'ValueTypeSerializer' for serializing value types, along with a generic internal class 'ValueTypeSerializer<T>' that provides serialization and deserialization logic for structs using .NET serialization interfaces. It contains methods for writing and reading value types with custom callbacks, handling serialization info, and managing field data.

classes.name: ValueTypeSerializer
classes.description: An abstract class defining basic serialization interface for value types, requiring methods for writing and reading values.

classes.name: ValueTypeSerializer<T>
classes.description: A generic internal class implementing value type serialization for structs, utilizing callbacks, reflection data, and serialization info.

methods.name: WriteValue
methods.description: Serializes a value, invoking serializing callbacks, collecting SerializationInfo, and writing fields to a buffer.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a value of type T, invoking deserializing callbacks and reconstructing the object from serialized data.
